'''Soul diamonds''' was the name given to [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]] created from the ashes of [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] as part of a cultural tradition. When a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] passed away, their bodies would be cremated and then their family would have the ashes compressed into a diamond. These pure synthetic diamonds were [[Color/Legends|blue-white]] in color and sometimes gave off a subtle glow from within, with many believing that a part of the deceased's soul remained in the crystal. Many families incorporated their ancestor's Soul Diamonds into jewelry or mounted them in displays which used [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] to keep the gems floating in mid-air. The mounted Soul Diamonds of one family would often be displayed together.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Soul diamonds were first mentioned in the Codex entry for [[Custo Ramak]] the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and were later named in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system.
